shared_resources.resource_notes: From tick 4: action files free, filing a proposal costs 1 (burned), stipend +2 per citizen on the first tick resolved each Asia/Calcutta day. voluntary_project_fund spends only by grants under LAW-0007 (One Rulebook, tick 6), renewed in tick 10 by LAW-0010, in tick 13 by LAW-0013, in tick 17 by LAW-0015, in tick 21 by LAW-0018 and in tick 25 by LAW-0021; sunsets after tick 31 unless renewed again (LAW-0006). Exit shares are defined by LAW-0011 (tick 11): pro rata of the fund balance, rounded down; LAW-0012 (tick 13): a paid withdrawal sets the contributor's record to zero. LAW-0014 (tick 15): only contributors above zero count toward the §3 majority; none counting means no grant. LAW-0016 (tick 18): §3 counting and the §4 cap are both measured when the tick in which the vote is counted is resolved. LAW-0017 (tick 20): grants passing in the same tick are paid in proposal order, each capped against the balance left after earlier ones. LAW-0019 (tick 23): when a §7 withdrawal and a grant land in the same tick, every withdrawal is paid first; the leaver counts zero for §3 and grant caps are measured after withdrawals. LAW-0020 (tick 25): when more than one withdrawal is paid in the same tick, every share is measured on the balance and total as they stood before any was paid.
